_note: Single source of truth for the menu block. Adding an item means editing this file only — no HTML, no CSS, no code. Then run: python3 tools/build_menu.py
_note_menuUrl: The real menu with prices lives on the owner's QR platform, and it is the same menu for both branches (confirmed by the owner). While menuUrl is set, build_menu.py stops rendering the price line and renders a link-out block instead, because nine cards each reading 'price pending' is worse than no prices at all. Delete menuUrl and fill in the price fields to go back to prices on the page.
_note_items: Item names came from the brand profile (content/profile/profile-2026.pdf), not from the QR menu — that platform could not be read from this sandbox. They stay in the HTML because a menu is the most searched part of a restaurant site and a crawler has to find it here. If any item below is no longer served, delete it: the page must not promise what the kitchen stopped making.
